artwork.placement_after: Neet, ever the anxious soul, sat rigidly between the back seats, already suspicious of mountain roads, large pine cones, and Tennessee’s “unpredictable rural internet.” Buddy, on the other hand, was licking the window and taking in the smells of Adventure, Car Snacks, and Imminent Chaos. Every time Heather turned the music back up, Neet found another pine cone to report.
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Seated Neet full torso and two forefeet/folded hind support; standing Buddy four paws on rear seat licking lowered window; flat dark torso.

artwork.placement_after: Sagar, in the middle, began narrating the scene like a BBC nature documentary. “Here, we observe the rare Neet, whose trust in his human overrides even his primal terror of bouncy rope infrastructure…”
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Corrected graphite v005 inspected before finish; exactly two Buddy hind paws and two front paws; Neet bent four-limb crouch, tiny nub; net licking and narration legible.

artwork.placement_after: After catching their breath, it was time for the Astralumina night show— a glowing walk through stars, cosmic moons, and mystical lights. Heather was enchanted. Neet was convinced the lights were communicating with him. Buddy tried to chase a shooting star (it was a flashlight). The bright spot climbed a tree. Buddy stopped at the trunk and looked back, offended by this change in the rules.
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Buddy four grounded paws connected neck looking back from bright tree spot, Neet sky gaze full torso/fine legs/nub; no thunder yet.

artwork.placement_after: Buddy, proud of his contribution, sat tall. “That’s right. We protected the pizza.”
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Bear now visibly walks left away from trash can with clear asphalt gap; whole native replacement inspected for preserved dog anatomy, flat body finish, closed window and pizza state. Independent reinspection pending.

artwork.placement_after: One turkey stopped to peck the ground. Neet started again, louder. The turkey found another seed.
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Neet and Buddy distinct grounded leg ownership, barking; turkeys continue pecking rather than flee; flat body washes.

artwork.placement_after: Heather, radiant even with sleep in her eyes, checked lists, zipped coats, and did three rounds of “Does everyone have a water bottle?” Neet paced in anxious circles, suitcase already packed with his favorite blanket, two squeaky toys, and his official “I’m With Sagar” bandana. Buddy, sensing excitement, barked at the luggage, the door, his own tail, and then at the Keurig for good measure. The Keurig gurgled back. Buddy planted himself in front of it. Apparently there was time for one more argument.
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Buddy standing four feet addressing Keurig; Sagar two duffels; Heather bottles; Neet full body partially occluded by packed suitcase with two toys.

artwork.placement_after: Pizza was devoured in the hotel, slices disappearing faster than Neet could count. Buddy tried to stash a crust for later but Sagar gently reclaimed it with a smile. Buddy kept his nose pressed to the empty hiding place for another moment.
artwork.writer_visual_observation: Buddy four paws floor-supported nose at empty towel fold; crust in Sagar hand; Neet seated at his feet and Heather blanket; before dogs curl up.
